question: What matched cold and query-only operation counts and local diagnostic elapsed ratios does recursive half-GCD produce against schoolbook, classical-Euclid/Newton and lookup, charging full factor-base construction?

claims.text: Complete ordered relation sets agree with scalar verification; double-query counted work is exactly twice single-query work.

Matched descriptive full-construction-plus-query counts and local elapsed ratios, stratified by configuration/population; clocks stay diagnostic belowL2 and do not establish an admitted timing improvement.

arms.description: Schoolbook multiplication/division and classical Euclid reference.
Same half-GCD in a distinct fresh process/layout; provides both A/A noise and the zero-algorithm-change negative null (not two independent panels).
Batched lookup after full factor-base/index construction.
Same half-GCD query executed twice under one context; timing/count positive control.

positive.expected_detection: Complete sets identical, query multiplication count exactly2x half on successful cells; timing positive detected only if paired median double/single query ratio>1.25 and exceeds A/A noise. Miss invalidates timing interpretation, not retained counts.

null_population.description: Zero algorithm change, independently exec-created process/layout; same A/A arm supplies the nuisance null, not a separate independent panel.

primary.name: Fresh construction plus query field multiplications
primary.definition: Every arm freshly executes descriptor/full sibling-fiber certification AND full point factor-base lifting; lookup also hashes. Primitive muls include inverse/sqrt internals. Memory/hash/sort unpriced in counts; included in clocks. Setup teardown, process startup, fixture draw and scalar verification excluded. All successful raw total_work fields equal construction_work+query_work.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Complete ordered pair array and SHA compared across all arms, then native BigUint scalar replay.

secondary.name: Local diagnostic cold/query elapsed intervals
secondary.definition: Monotonic Instant: cold starts before fresh construction context and ends after query; separate query clock starts after construction. Full point-base construction charged for all arms; setup remains alive through clocks, teardown/process startup/external fixtures/scalar verification excluded. Clocks belowL2 remain wall_valid=false; ratio is a local descriptive diagnostic, not admitted speedup.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: 6 configurations*6 arms*(2+12)=504 calls;60s/4e9 multiplications per construction/query stage,65536 splitting attempts,135s per worker; configuration cap400s calibration/1400s primary, outer7200s. No retries. Failures/timeouts/missing retained.

Complete-set mismatch or first double-query positive failure invalidates instrument and stops; preserve failed row and missing remainder. Ordinary budget failures retained and later arms/configurations continue. Timing control miss prevents timing interpretation.

decision_rule.text: Report native matched cold/query counts and elapsed ratios with min/median/bootstrap95 intervals and A/A ranges per configuration/population/identity. Any censored/missing counterpart prevents complete-cell speed assertion. Positive count2x mandatory; timing control threshold>1.25 and outside A/A. All clocks diagnostic belowL2, no admitted timing/exponent/fastest/whole-DLP inference.
decision_rule.statistic: Frozen Rust median/min/max/all values and4096 percentile bootstrap resampling of each paired ratio.
decision_rule.interval: Observed range, not a confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: newton/half, half/lookup at total-arithmetic and query-only scope; half/half-aa and lookup/lookup-fast are deterministic count controls.
